adat.title: Adat Dalem Tamblingan
adat.subtitle: Profile of the region and its indigenous community
adat.body1: The Adat Dalem Tamblingan region comprises four villages - Gobleg, Munduk, Gesing, and Umejero - united by shared history, custom, and a spiritual bond with Lake Tamblingan.
adat.body2: The indigenous community preserves traditions, rituals, and local wisdom passed down through generations, while caring for the surrounding nature.

kkn.title: KKN Mekar Banjar
kkn.subtitle: Community service program
kkn.body1: This website was developed by the KKN Mekar Banjar team as part of a community service program to promote the tourism and cultural potential of the Adat Dalem Tamblingan region.
kkn.body2: We collaborate with residents and customary leaders to document the stories, destinations, and village life so they can reach a wider audience.
